ci-browser: queue-only because PR lint/typecheck and unit tests check desktop, UI and extension sources; only the queue executes their browser specs and extension boundary behavior
migration-upgrade-rehearsal: queue-only because PR lint/typecheck, migration guards and scoped database suites check API changes; only the queue rehearses final queued migrations against the promoted release schema at scale, including rerun and schema parity
mobile-build: queue-only because PR lint/typecheck and scoped unit tests check mobile sources; only the queue runs Expo doctor and Android, iOS and web exports to validate the dependency graph and Metro/Babel platform resolution
stack-redaction-browsers: queue-only because PR lint/typecheck checks analytics sources and browser specs, and unit tests check redaction logic; only the queue executes stack-redaction assertions in Firefox and WebKit
e2e-vite-canary: queue-only because the development-server canary supplements production PR coverage in the merged-tree tier
e2e-landing: queue-only because the production-preview landing browser suite retains the merged-tree browser tier
